representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands a comparison-panel for few, high-density, location-sensitive options with comparison required; implementation delivers a side-by-side table of 9 metric rows + weighted 综合得分 (source/index.html:249-258) over 5 candidate locations, paired with a schematic map marking office, pins, and commute isochrones (source/index.html:165-203). Comparison state persists in-place per panel header '比较状态驻留本屏' (source/index.html:108).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Decide task dominates the initial screen at both 1280x860 and 1440x900: top-right verdict badge '推荐 B·望山巷（综合 65 分）', #1 rank chip on the winning column, ▲/green best-cell highlighting per row, and a 决策备注 explaining the winner vs runner-up under current weights (screenshots/1280x860.png; source/index.html:264-268).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: what/where is conveyed immediately via h1+subtitle '驻点决策台 · 候选选址对比面板 · 地理语境与决策项同屏' (source/index.html:87-88) and instructional card headers '区位图 · 点击图钉加入/移出对比' (source/index.html:94) and '并排对比' (source/index.html:108); map legend decodes pin colors and dashed isochrones (source/index.html:97-102).

navigation_cost.evidence: Single static page, no routes or modes; reaching a candidate's decision data costs 0 steps (all 5 sites visible: 3 in table + 2 chips, screenshots/1440x900.png) and adding one costs 1 click on pin or chip (source/index.html:198, 278); keyboard path exists (pin tabindex/role=button, Enter/Space, source/index.html:195-199); URL params '?cmp=ABCD&wr=…' deep-link comparison state (source/index.html:316-326).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions re-render in place with no navigation: toggle/remove rebuild the same table (source/index.html:295-304), weight sliders live-update (source/index.html:305-308), limits surface as a toast rather than a dialog (source/index.html:297, 300); cross-highlighting ties map hover to table columns bidirectionally (source/index.html:207-221); source/shots/03-two-candidates.png shows a reduced 2-candidate state retaining global ranks (#4, #5) and chips for re-entry.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly: header+verdict, map card, 3 weight sliders + reset (source/index.html:110-113), comparison table with per-column ✕ (source/index.html:246), decision note, and bench chips (source/index.html:119-122); no settings/auth/extraneous features. High density matches the brief's density:high facet; chips hidden once compared keeps the bench at 0-2 items (source/index.html:274).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails every administered a11y/typography check: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json:13-16). Semantic groundwork is real (SVG role=img aria-label source/index.html:96; pins role=button+aria-label+keyboard source/index.html:195-199; chips are <button> source/index.html:275) but undermined by small targets (r=13 pin dots, source/index.html:196), 10-11px map annotations (source/index.html:181-188), low-contrast muted tones (e.g. remove ✕ #b9b3a4 on white, source/index.html:61), and a .focus-ring CSS rule (source/index.html:34-35) whose element is never created in buildMap, leaving keyboard focus on pins without the intended visible ring.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects and all layout receipt checks pass — layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass (measurement-summary.json:11-12) — across 1280x860, 1440x900, and both interaction states (source/shots/02-four-candidates.png 4 columns, 03-two-candidates.png 2 columns, no collision/truncation). Deduction: type.min_projected_size=fail is a visible-class defect (sub-minimum 10-11px text, source/index.html:181-188) plus 1 unitemized warning (measurement-summary.json:7).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '地理语境与决策项同屏' is directly satisfied: map with office, candidate pins, park/river and dashed 通勤等时线 is on the same screen as the comparison table at both viewports (screenshots/1280x860.png, screenshots/1440x900.png); the subtitle states the seed verbatim (source/index.html:88) and isochrones encode commute geography into the decision (source/index.html:185-188).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size all fail in the receipt (measurement-summary.json:13-16)
Keyboard focus indicator for map pins is not rendered: .pin.focus-ring CSS (source/index.html:34-35) has no matching element created in buildMap (source/index.html:194-202)
Column remove control is a non-focusable span with click-only handler (source/index.html:246, 262), contributing to focus_order failure
Very small projected text on map annotations (font-size 10-11px, source/index.html:181-188) consistent with type.min_projected_size failure
1 warning in the receipt summary is not itemized (measurement-summary.json:7)
missing_evidence: Per-element detail of which elements failed a11y.contrast / a11y.target_size / a11y.focus_order (sanitized receipt gives check ids only)
Identity of the single warning counted in measurement-summary.json:7
No evidence of rendering at viewports other than 1280x860 and 1440x900
scores.overall_note: The package is a single-page选址 comparison panel that matches the brief's decide × comparison-panel cell almost exactly: five location candidates shown on a schematic isochrone map beside a dense side-by-side table with per-row best highlighting, adjustable rent/commute/quality weights that re-rank live, a persistent verdict badge, and a decision note comparing the winner to the runner-up — decision inputs are co-present at load (data inline, no loading state, source/index.html:129-139) and every interaction state shown (2 and 4 candidates, changed weights) stays on the same screen with context intact (source/shots/*.png), satisfying the acceptance seed and scoring well on fit, salience, navigation, context, and complexity. The clear weakness is accessibility: all three administered a11y checks plus minimum type size fail (measurement-summary.json:13-16), with good semantic groundwork (ARIA roles, labels, keyboard handlers) undercut by contrast, small targets, sub-minimum text, and an unimplemented focus-ring; layout quality itself is clean at both viewports. These judgments are from screenshots, source, and the receipt only; task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot, and model-judged time_to_understand is a proxy, not a human reading.
